description: Verified reference sources for Stalthosian Archipelago species definitions. Each entry has been checked for HTTP accessibility, real page title, and actual license terms. Sources with unverifiable licenses are in unverified.json.

sources.resolved_title: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy: Araucaria araucana (Molina) K.Koch
sources.license_verification_method: DOWNGRADED by operator: the endpoint resolved (HTTP 200) but the licence TEXT was never retrieved. GBIF terms page returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; the PBDF site is JS-rendered and serves no machine-readable licence statement. The original claim "data explicitly CC0" was asserted, not verified. Both GBIF and PBDF publish per-dataset licences that may include CC-BY-NC (non-commercial), which would conflict with redistribution.
sources.operator_action_required: Retrieve the licence text in a browser (GBIF dataset page / PBDF data-use statement) and set license, license_verification_method and redistributable accordingly. Until then treat as non-redistributable.

summary.note: Operator correction: 11 taxonomic/paleontological database entries were downgraded from a blanket CC0 claim to license=unverified, redistributable=false. The endpoints resolve but the licence text was never actually retrieved. 2 sources (1 Wikimedia CC BY 3.0 US image, Poly Haven CC0) are genuinely verified. This is a personal non-commercial project, so non-redistributable data may still be referenceable; it must not be marked redistributable until verified.
